current.ui: daisyUI 5 / Tailwind CSS 4 with bea themes; content-hashed static URLs; usage guide at /usage; admin area at /admin

admin.access_policy: Paste administrators (allow; same administrator emails as ip.bea.sh)
admin.note: Issuer, audience, and administrator emails are Worker secrets and are not recorded here.

admin_gate: paste.bea.sh/admin and /admin/api/* redirect signed-out users to Cloudflare Access
workers.dev /admin returns 403 without a token and with a forged token
verification.paste_metadata: new paste recorded size, client, country, creator IP, and 30-day TTL; test paste deleted
verification.signed_in_dashboard: verified locally with a stubbed sign-in; production sign-in to be confirmed by the administrator

initial_deployment.migration: Fresh D1 database; no old pastes migrated

verification.fixture_cleanup: pastes and chunks both zero after production tests
verification.rendered_ui: production /new, paste view, encrypted paste, delete, light/dark and mobile layouts inspected in the in-app browser
